sam.sdk: heads up — onboarding report: starter app crashes in edge preview with "Unexpected token 'export'". Looks like ESM/CJS mixup.
eli.build: repro steps? package.json type? tsconfig? bundler flags?
sam.sdk: package.json has "type": "module" because teams prefer ESM. tsconfig module=esnext, moduleResolution=node. esbuild command: `esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/worker.js --format=iife --platform=browser`.
zoe-dx: iife+module:type=module is often wrong for edge. If esbuild leaves export tokens in a wrapper, the runtime fails. Try `--format=esm` for edge or bundle SDK into the file.
eli.build: also check package exports map. Node will pick import entry when type=module. If your final bundle still references the SDK entry, it might resolve to esm path.
sam.sdk: tried adding exports map pointing import->dist/esm/index.js and require->dist/cjs/index.js but edge still blew up.
zoe-dx: likely esbuild didn't transpile module syntax. For edge prefer format=esm and target=es2020 OR set esbuild loader/transform to strip exports. Another faster fix for starter: set package.json without type field and explicitly use `.mjs` for ESM samples.
eli.build: separate but related: typings regression — client.request<T>() inference is lost because retry wrapper typed as any. We should change `withRetry(fn: () => Promise<any>): Promise<any>` to `withRetry<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T>`.
sam.sdk: agreed. also replace public overloads like `request<T = any>(opts: Options<T>): Promise<T>` with `request<T = unknown>(opts: Options<T>): Promise<T>` and avoid a second any-based overload.
zoe-dx: add tsd tests to assert `const r = await client.request<{id:number}>({})` so CI fails on regressions. For starter template, set skipLibCheck: true to lower noisy errors for newbies until typings are fully cleaned.
bot-ci: CI job queued: sample-edge-build-check (runs on maria/sdk-edge-fixes).
eli.build: ok open PRs for (1) retry generic fix + tsd tests, (2) starter README note about package.type + esbuild flags, (3) starter tsconfig change skipLibCheck=true. I'll review.
sam.sdk: thanks — these onboarding tickets were piling up. will PR today.
